pages.text: I. Hellas is open from the start: iron is enough. Half-bosses: the Nemean Lion, Medusa, the Cyclops. Bosses: the Minotaur (300), the Hydra (400), Cerberus (450).
II. Nav is opened by the Minotaur's horn: the acorn of the World Tree needs it. The two worlds can be travelled side by side. Bosses: Solovei (300), Zmey Gorynych (500), Koschei (550).

III. Jotunheim is the harshest. The rune igniter needs a fang of Cerberus and a scale of Zmey Gorynych. Bosses: the Draugr Chieftain (350), Garm (400), Heimdall (450), Thrym (550), Fenrir (650), Surtr (800).$(br)IV. Victory over Surtr opens the chapter of the far worlds.
A boss counts for every player within 64 blocks of it: on a server, friends walk the path together.
